blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Kanlaon Volcano on Negros Island emitted ash on Monday morning, the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) reported. According to Phivolcs, the ash emission was observed from 6:35 a.m. to 7:55 a.m. “The event generated grayish plumes that rose up to 350 meters above the summit crater before drifting southwest, as captured by the Kanlaon Volcano Observatory – Canlaon City IP camera,” Phivolcs said. On Sunday, state seismologists recorded four ash emissions over the volcano, triggering ashfall in parts of La Carlota City and La Castellana in Negros Occidental.
